_comment: Copy the 'dolibarr' entry into any MCP client's server map. OMP expands ${HOME}; clients that do not (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ...) need an absolute path, e.g. /home/arthur/.claude/mcp-servers/dolibarr/server.mjs. Uses 'node' (Node >= 20); 'bun' also works. The server loads its own secret from ~/.secrets/dolibarr.env — no token in this file.
